notes.title: Patch 1.01 is here!
notes.content:
Dear Cultists,

[b]We hope that we solved some of your problems with LUST FROM BEYOND: PROLOGUE![/b]

Changes:
- Solved problem with opening tabernacle after the puzzle
- Improved conditions to get following achievements: Eternal delight, Sinner
- Solved problem with repeating text in conversation with Theodore
- Little optimization

Also - [b]Thanks for your amazing opinions! It means a lot for us![/b]
We have some gift for you - just look at this new art!
Are you ready to meet the Scarlet Lodge in the full game?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100281/3ad8352576a6b206463d8d7148462ecca330ebf0.jpg[/img]

Watch for another updates!
[i]Yv'h lauv'abrarc! Yv'h Lusst'ghaa! [/i]
